The lens on your live save. — sports data analytics · Football Manager companion desktop app

Idea

Where it sits
quietloud

Feels
quietprecisealert
The idea

A blip on the night pitch: a dark instrument field, wide tracked capitals set like scoreboard fine print, and exactly one lit green mark.

One loud thing

The signal-green blip is the only saturated colour anywhere.

Where it differs

The competitor shelf is community-forum red and unstyled Arial; Signal reads as an instrument — dark, quiet, one lit mark — not as a website theme.

The mark

The pitch seen from above at night: the ring, the halfway line, and one lit dot — the player worth your time.

Brand guidelinesVersion 1.0October, 2026
03

Logo

The symbol + wordmark is the primary logo. Use it wherever the space allows; every other version is derived from it.

Clear space

Keep at least x = 1 × the wordmark's cap height free on every side. (inferred from the drawing; confirm before print)

  • Use the supplied files in kit/logo; never retype or redraw the wordmark.
  • Scale proportionally, from the corner.
  • The guide lines show the cap height and baseline the lockup is aligned on.

Brand guidelinesVersion 1.0October, 2026
04

Logo

Pick the version by the space, not by taste. When the primary logo would render smaller than 16 px tall, switch to the symbol.

Primary

Horizontal lockup. The default for headers, documents and signage.

Stacked

For square and narrow spaces where the horizontal lockup gets too small.

Symbol

On its own only where the brand is already named nearby: avatars, app icons.

Favicon

The symbol on the primary colour at 48, 32 and 16 px.

Brand guidelinesVersion 1.0October, 2026
05

Every logo part keeps at least 3:1 against its ground. Where the colours cannot, the logo switches to one colour.

Logo

Paper · one colour · 19.2:1
Primary · one colour · 9.7:1
Ink · one colour · 17.1:1
Ground · full colour · 1.8:1
Don't stretch
Don't recolour
Don't use low contrast
Don't outline
The blip never sits on the centerline — the player is found off it
Never fill the pitch: the mark is a line, not a surface

Brand guidelinesVersion 1.0October, 2026
06

Night-slate ground with one signal-green blip.

Colours

Band heights show how much of each colour a typical page uses. Large areas take the ground and primary; the accent stays small.

Print

Screen values are exact. For print, ask your printer for CMYK/Pantone matches made with their profile; the Lab D50 values are the reference to match against.

Tints

80, 50 and 20% for charts and backgrounds only, never for text.
